focus.title: 欧盟拟就碳边境调节机制发布实施细则，中国出口企业需提前布局碳核算与合规申报
focus.summary: 据欧盟委员会近期通报，CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起正式征收碳关税。最新实施细则草案要求进口商提交经第三方核验的碳排放数据，并明确中国等非豁免国家出口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢能产品的核算标准。中国出口企业应尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，评估欧盟认可核证机构，避免因数据不合规导致清关受阻或额外成本。建议企业结合现有ISO 14064体系，开展差距分析，并关注后续正式文本的发布。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司通报 · 2026.08.27
focus.title_en: EU to Publish Implementing Rules on CBAM, Chinese Exporters Urged to Prepare Carbon Accounting and Compliance Filings
focus.summary_en: According to recent communications from the European Commission, the CBAM transitional period will end in 2026, with definitive levy starting in 2027. The latest draft implementing rules require importers to submit third-party verified carbon emission data, and specify calculation standards for steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, and hydrogen from non-exempt countries like China. Chinese exporters should promptly establish product-level carbon footprint accounting systems, evaluate EU-recognized verification bodies, and avoid customs delays or extra costs due to non-compliance. It is recommended that companies conduct gap analyses based on existing ISO 14064 systems and monitor subsequent official texts.
focus.source_en: Source: Communication from DG CLIMA, European Commission · 2026.08.27

case.title: 最高法发布涉外商事典型案例：明确独立保函欺诈例外适用标准，维护跨境交易安全
case.summary: 最高人民法院近期发布涉外商事海事典型案例，其中一起涉及独立保函欺诈纠纷。法院认定，受益人明知基础交易不存在仍索款，构成欺诈，适用欺诈例外原则，支持申请人止付申请。判决明确了独立保函独立性与欺诈例外的界限，强调银行仅负单据表面审查义务，但受益人滥用权利不受保护。该案为中国企业在跨境工程、贸易中使用独立保函提供了风险提示：应审慎审查基础合同真实性，留存交易凭证，若遇恶意索款，可及时申请法院止付令。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院涉外商事典型案例发布（2026年8月）
case.title_en: SPC Releases Typical Foreign-Related Commercial Cases: Clarifies Fraud Exception Standard for Demand Guarantees, Safeguarding Cross-Border Transactions
case.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court recently released typical foreign-related commercial and maritime cases, including one involving a dispute over fraud in an independent demand guarantee. The court held that a beneficiary's claim for payment while knowing the underlying transaction does not exist constitutes fraud, thus applying the fraud exception and supporting the applicant's application for a payment injunction. The judgment clarifies the boundary between the independence of demand guarantees and the fraud exception, emphasizing that banks only have a duty to examine documents on their face, but beneficiaries who abuse their rights are not protected. This case provides risk warnings for Chinese enterprises using demand guarantees in cross-border projects and trade: they should carefully verify the authenticity of underlying contracts, retain transaction evidence, and promptly seek court injunctions against malicious claims.
case.source_en: Source: SPC Typical Foreign-Related Commercial Cases (August 2026)

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地：企业数据出境合规再获便利，负面清单管理成亮点
policy.summary: 国家网信办与广东省政府联合发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规定（试行）》，自2026年10月1日起施行。新规在大湾区内地九市与香港、澳门之间实施数据出境负面清单管理，清单外的一般数据可自由流动，无需单独申报。同时，建立大湾区数据跨境流动“白名单”认证机制，对符合条件的企业给予快速审批通道。此举显著降低企业合规成本，但涉及重要数据、个人信息出境仍需履行安全评估或标准合同备案。建议企业梳理数据资产，对照负面清单，及时调整内部数据管理流程。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室 · 广东省人民政府联合发布 · 2026.08.27
policy.title_en: New GBA Cross-Border Data Flow Rules Take Effect: Data Outbound Compliance Facilitated with Negative List Management
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and the Guangdong Provincial Government jointly issued the 'Provisions on the Administration of Cross-Border Data Flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', effective from October 1, 2026. The new rules implement a negative list management for data outbound transfer between the nine mainland cities in the GBA and Hong Kong/Macau, allowing general data outside the list to flow freely without separate filing. Additionally, a 'whitelist' certification mechanism for data cross-border flow is established, providing fast-track approval for qualified enterprises. This significantly reduces compliance costs, but transfer of important data and personal information still requires security assessment or standard contract filing. Companies are advised to sort their data assets, compare with the negative list, and adjust internal data management processes accordingly.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of China & People's Government of Guangdong Province · 2026.08.27

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国出口管制实体清单扩容，中国芯片企业应建立全链条合规筛查机制
analysis.summary: 美国商务部工业与安全局近期宣布将多家中国芯片设计、制造及设备企业列入实体清单，限制其获取美国技术及产品。秦林蒿律师研判：此类清单扩容已成常态，企业不应仅依赖外部律师的临时应对，而应建立内部全链条出口管制合规体系，包括：对产品、技术、软件进行ECCN分类；对供应商、客户进行受制裁主体筛查；在合同中加入出口管制合规条款；对员工开展培训。同时，关注“外国直接产品规则”的适用，评估使用美国工具或软件生产的产品的风险。建议企业定期与专业机构合作，更新筛查数据库，以降低违规风险。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: US Entity List Expansion Targets Chinese Chip Firms, Full-Chain Compliance Screening Mechanism Needed
analysis.summary_en: The US Bureau of Industry and Security recently added several Chinese chip design, manufacturing, and equipment companies to the Entity List, restricting their access to US technology and products. Attorney Qin Linhao's view: such list expansion has become routine, and enterprises should not rely solely on ad-hoc external counsel responses but should establish an internal full-chain export control compliance system, including: classifying products, technology, and software under ECCN; screening suppliers and customers against sanctioned party lists; incorporating export control compliance clauses in contracts; and training employees. Also, pay attention to the applicability of the Foreign Direct Product Rules, assessing risks of products manufactured using US tools or software. It is recommended that enterprises regularly cooperate with professional institutions to update screening databases to reduce compliance risks.
